cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(agent_demo C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

option(ENABLE_ASAN "Enable AddressSanitizer for memory debugging" OFF)

# Kconfig configuration (optional): this demo's .config (generated by running
# menuconfig in this directory) is imported automatically; y/n values are
# normalized to ON/OFF by core's TuyaOpenOptions. Priority: -D command line >
# .config > built-in defaults below.
set(TUYAOPEN_DOTCONFIG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.config")
if(EXISTS "${TUYAOPEN_DOTCONFIG}")
    file(STRINGS "${TUYAOPEN_DOTCONFIG}" _tuyaopen_kconfig_lines)
    foreach(_tuyaopen_line IN LISTS _tuyaopen_kconfig_lines)
        if(_tuyaopen_line MATCHES "^CONFIG_([A-Z0-9_]+)=(y|n)$")
            if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
                set(CONFIG_${CMAKE_MATCH_1} ${CMAKE_MATCH_2})
            endif()
        elseif(_tuyaopen_line MATCHES "^# CONFIG_([A-Z0-9_]+) is not set$")
            # switches disabled by menuconfig (default-on switches must accept this form, otherwise they cannot be turned off)
            if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
                set(CONFIG_${CMAKE_MATCH_1} n)
            endif()
        elseif(_tuyaopen_line MATCHES "^CONFIG_([A-Z0-9_]+)=(.+)$")
            # int/string options: kconfiglib string values carry quotes (an empty
            # string is written as CONFIG_X=""); strip the outer quotes before
            # storing. Note that string(REGEX REPLACE) overwrites CMAKE_MATCH_*,
            # so both the variable name and the value must be copied into local
            # variables before touching REGEX.
            if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
                set(_tuyaopen_name "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
                set(_tuyaopen_val "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
                string(REGEX REPLACE "^\"(.*)\"$" "\\1" _tuyaopen_val "${_tuyaopen_val}")
                set(CONFIG_${_tuyaopen_name} "${_tuyaopen_val}")
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    unset(_tuyaopen_line)
    unset(_tuyaopen_name)
    unset(_tuyaopen_val)
    unset(_tuyaopen_kconfig_lines)
endif()
unset(TUYAOPEN_DOTCONFIG)

# Built-in defaults: switches required by the whole AI link (wired demo, QR code used for scan binding)
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_COMPONENTS)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_COMPONENTS ON)
endif()
# MCP tool service (src/components/ai_mcp): the demo calls ai_mcp_init() in
# tuya_main.c to wire it up, and the cloud can list/call device tools over MCP
# (current tool list in ai_mcp_tools.c)
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_COMP_AI_MCP)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_COMP_AI_MCP ON)
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_WIRED)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_WIRED ON)
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_QRCODE)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_QRCODE ON)
endif()
# Downlink audio playback: the AI player (audio_player) and its platform consumer.
# - CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_PLAYER: the audio_player module + the port's ALSA consumer
#   + the core_fs card (for the file source); without it there is no playback;
# - CONFIG_ENABLE_COMP_AI_AUDIO: the ai_audio component (ai_audio_player_init
#   wraps svc_ai_player); the wiring call in tuya_main.c is guarded by this macro.
# Both default to ON (turning them off requires an explicit -D or "is not set" in .config)
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_PLAYER)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_PLAYER ON)
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_ENABLE_COMP_AI_AUDIO)
    set(CONFIG_ENABLE_COMP_AI_AUDIO ON)
endif()

# Sample path default (matches the Kconfig default; an empty value uses voice_16k.pcm in the build directory)
if(NOT DEFINED CONFIG_AGENT_DEMO_AUDIO_FILE)
    set(CONFIG_AGENT_DEMO_AUDIO_FILE "")
endif()

# Credentials are optional: when unset the defaults in include/tuya_config.h
# are used, or put a tuya_config_secrets.h in include/ (see the .example file)
if(NOT TUYA_PRODUCT_ID AND DEFINED ENV{TUYA_PRODUCT_ID})
    set(TUYA_PRODUCT_ID "$ENV{TUYA_PRODUCT_ID}")
endif()
if(NOT TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID AND DEFINED ENV{TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID})
    set(TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID "$ENV{TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID}")
endif()
if(NOT TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY AND DEFINED ENV{TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY})
    set(TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY "$ENV{TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY}")
endif()

# The examples live inside the core repository; the core root is three levels
# up and carries its linux port under port/linux. -D can point at any other copy.
set(TUYAOPEN_CORE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." CACHE PATH "tuyaopen-core repository path")
set(TUYAOPEN_PORT_DIR "${TUYAOPEN_CORE_DIR}/port/linux" CACHE PATH "linux TKL port directory")
get_filename_component(TUYAOPEN_CORE_DIR "${TUYAOPEN_CORE_DIR}" ABSOLUTE)
get_filename_component(TUYAOPEN_PORT_DIR "${TUYAOPEN_PORT_DIR}" ABSOLUTE)

# 1) core: single entry tuyaopen-core.cmake (switch macro injection, five groups and aggregation all happen here)
include(${TUYAOPEN_CORE_DIR}/tuyaopen-core.cmake)

# 2) port: self-contained subdirectory (creates tuyaopen-port and injects headers into tuyaopen-headers)
add_subdirectory(${TUYAOPEN_PORT_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tuyaopen-port)

# 3) common component: qrcode (examples/components/qrcode, shared by the iot/agent/p2p demos, gated by CONFIG_ENABLE_QRCODE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../components/qrcode/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "agent_demo must be built inside the examples tree (it reuses the common qrcode component): cannot find ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../components/qrcode/CMakeLists.txt")
endif()
add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../components/qrcode ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/qrcode)

# 4) Application-side AI components (see src/components/): utility (event bus) /
#    audio_player (player core) / ai_audio (TTS/music orchestration) / ai_agent
#    (application wrapper) / ai_skills (downlink text parsing) / ai_mcp (MCP
#    tool set). Order: audio_player comes before ai_audio/ai_agent/ai_skills
#    (the latter three orchestrate playback through its svc_ai_player
#    interface). Each component gates itself (ENABLE_AI_PLAYER /
#    ENABLE_COMP_AI_AUDIO / ENABLE_COMP_AI_MCP); when off the corresponding
#    target does not exist and must be filtered before linking.
#    The master switch: when ENABLE_AI_COMPONENTS is off the components do not
#    participate at all — they depend on tuya_ai_service headers such as
#    base_event.h and cannot compile when the service layer is not built.
set(_agent_demo_components utility audio_player ai_audio ai_agent ai_skills ai_mcp)
if(CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_COMPONENTS)
    foreach(_agent_demo_comp IN LISTS _agent_demo_components)
        add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/components/${_agent_demo_comp}
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/components/${_agent_demo_comp})
    endforeach()
endif()

# Audio data source narrowing (FILE bit off): agent_demo actually plays only
# MEM (TTS stream) and URL (TTS URL/music) sources — the only FILE source entry,
# ai_audio_play_local(), has no callers.
# With the bit off, datasink dispatch (ai_player_datasink.c) no longer references
# g_datasink_file → datasink_file.o and core_fs.o are not linked → no dependency
# on the filesystem card. src/adapt/fs_card.c (compiled in this directory, ready
# for use) stands by: restoring the FILE source only requires removing this
# injection (the card is already in place). The injection targets the
# audio_player library — the macro is defined in svc_ai_player.h and its only
# consumer is ai_player_datasink.c.
if(TARGET audio_player)
    target_compile_definitions(audio_player PRIVATE
        "AI_PLAYER_DATASINK=(AI_PLAYER_DATASINK_MEM|AI_PLAYER_DATASINK_URL)")
endif()

# 5) Voice sample: copied to the build directory at configure time for the default path "voice_16k.pcm"
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/voice_16k.pcm ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/voice_16k.pcm COPYONLY)

file(GLOB _agent_demo_srcs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c"
)
# Platform adaptation layer (src/adapt/: the real-device replacement points — play_local_in/out, fs_card) collected with the root sources
file(GLOB _agent_demo_adapt_srcs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/adapt/*.c"
)
list(APPEND _agent_demo_srcs ${_agent_demo_adapt_srcs})
unset(_agent_demo_adapt_srcs)
# Selftests (selftest/ directory, standalone targets with their own main()) are
# outside this GLOB and need no filtering
# Audio output endpoint (adapt/play_local_out.c): depends on the audio_player
# component header (svc_ai_player.h) and is gated by ENABLE_AI_PLAYER — added
# conditionally below
list(FILTER _agent_demo_srcs EXCLUDE REGEX "/play_local_out\\.c$")

add_executable(agent_demo ${_agent_demo_srcs})

target_include_directories(agent_demo PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

# Audio output endpoint (adapt/play_local_out.c): writes the PCM decoded by
# svc_ai_player into ALSA (16k/16bit/mono). It depends on the audio_player
# component header svc_ai_player.h — the component is gated by
# ENABLE_AI_PLAYER and the header does not exist when it is off, so the source
# and the libasound link follow the switch together. libasound is detected via
# pkg-config, with a fallback to the library name (provided by libasound2-dev).
if(CONFIG_ENABLE_AI_PLAYER)
    target_sources(agent_demo PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/adapt/play_local_out.c)
    find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
    if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(ALSA alsa QUIET)
    endif()
    if(ALSA_FOUND)
        target_include_directories(agent_demo PRIVATE ${ALSA_INCLUDE_DIRS})
        target_link_libraries(agent_demo PRIVATE ${ALSA_LIBRARIES})
    else()
        target_link_libraries(agent_demo PRIVATE asound)
    endif()
endif()

# Explicitly provided credentials override the #ifndef defaults in tuya_config.h
if(TUYA_PRODUCT_ID)
    target_compile_definitions(agent_demo PRIVATE TUYA_PRODUCT_ID="${TUYA_PRODUCT_ID}")
endif()
if(TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID)
    target_compile_definitions(agent_demo PRIVATE TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID="${TUYA_OPENSDK_UUID}")
endif()
if(TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY)
    target_compile_definitions(agent_demo PRIVATE TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY="${TUYA_OPENSDK_AUTHKEY}")
endif()

# Demo parameter injection (shared by the app and the link selftest)
# Sample path: use the given file when non-empty (default: voice_16k.pcm in the build directory)
set(_agent_demo_defs
    AGENT_DEMO_AUDIO_FILE="${CONFIG_AGENT_DEMO_AUDIO_FILE}"
)
target_compile_definitions(agent_demo PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_defs})

# App link: one group wraps the core libraries, application-side components and
# port together (resolving circular references between CORE/cloud services and
# application components/TKL); outside the group, tuyaopen-port provides include
# paths and tuyaopen-headers provides switch macro injection and port headers
# (the app's own sources also need ENABLE_* and TKL headers).
# Application component targets may be missing depending on switches (each
# CMakeLists gates itself); filter before grouping.
set(_agent_demo_comp_libs)
foreach(_agent_demo_comp IN LISTS _agent_demo_components)
    if(TARGET ${_agent_demo_comp})
        list(APPEND _agent_demo_comp_libs ${_agent_demo_comp})
    endif()
endforeach()

set(_agent_demo_link
    -Wl,--start-group
    ${TUYAOPEN_CORE_LIBS}
    ${_agent_demo_comp_libs}
    $<TARGET_FILE:tuyaopen-port>
)
list(APPEND _agent_demo_link -Wl,--end-group tuyaopen-port tuyaopen-headers)
target_link_libraries(agent_demo PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_link})

# Link selftest (standalone executable, linked with the same library group as agent_demo):
# verifies sample loading → frame splitting → boundaries without a cloud connection (no network or credentials)
# tests only the application-side play_local_in_* contract (the upload orchestration depends on the AI client context and belongs to online runtime testing)
add_executable(agent_chain_selftest
    selftest/agent_chain_selftest.c
    src/adapt/play_local_in.c
)
target_include_directories(agent_chain_selftest PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
target_compile_definitions(agent_chain_selftest PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_defs})
target_link_libraries(agent_chain_selftest PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_link})

# Downlink consumption selftest (standalone executable): builds STOP events (with a non-empty final segment) to verify the downlink consumption policy
# (the final segment carried by STOP must be printed) — regression guard, independent of the cloud packetization
# agent_audio.c contains the downlink callback (the ASR branch calls the uplink verify notify) and the uplink implementation, so it must be linked in;
# the play_local_in_* contract implementation it references (src/adapt/play_local_in.c) must be linked as well
add_executable(agent_nlg_selftest
    selftest/agent_nlg_selftest.c
    src/agent_audio.c
    src/adapt/play_local_in.c
)
target_include_directories(agent_nlg_selftest PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
target_link_libraries(agent_nlg_selftest PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_link})

# http_manager URL parsing boundary selftest (standalone executable, no network needed):
# out-of-range ports must be rejected by the parser (uint16 wraparound would silently connect to a wrong port / fall back to the default port)
add_executable(agent_http_selftest
    selftest/agent_http_selftest.c
)
target_include_directories(agent_http_selftest PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
target_link_libraries(agent_http_selftest PRIVATE ${_agent_demo_link})

# Injection scope of _agent_demo_defs for selftest targets: chain_selftest uses
# AGENT_DEMO_AUDIO_FILE, so it is injected there; the nlg/http selftests do not
# read the sample path and do not get the definition.
# If a future selftest really reads the sample path, make sure to inject the
# macro there too, otherwise it would silently test the bundled sample.
unset(_agent_demo_link)
unset(_agent_demo_defs)
unset(_agent_demo_components)
unset(_agent_demo_comp_libs)
unset(_agent_demo_comp)

# qrcode has no circular dependency and is linked outside the group; when the switch is off the target is not registered and is skipped
if(TARGET qrcode)
    target_link_libraries(agent_demo PRIVATE qrcode)
endif()

if(ENABLE_ASAN)
    target_compile_options(agent_demo PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g)
    target_link_options(agent_demo PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
    target_compile_options(agent_chain_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g)
    target_link_options(agent_chain_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
    target_compile_options(agent_nlg_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g)
    target_link_options(agent_nlg_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
    target_compile_options(agent_http_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g)
    target_link_options(agent_http_selftest PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
endif()
